a:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished raster concept for Quackies, a landscape iPad mini tabletop board game. Create ONE full-screen front-on game UI, not a device photograph and not a multi-panel comparison.
Input images: image 1 is the approved three-biome physical illustrated board, preserve its recognizable wetland/meadow/desert layout, nest upper left and oasis upper right as the existing backdrop in this new UI concept; image 2 is the approved cardboard duck token style; image 3 is approved orange rounded-triangle seed token.
Primary request: demonstrate an integrated NIGHT / DREAM phase where the adventure board stays visible and a physical fold-out dream tray opens across the lower 45% of screen. This is a presentation concept, no gameplay implementation.
Composition: 1536x1024 landscape. Narrow midnight-blue top header; upper 45% shows the referenced landscape in beautiful clear moonlight with some representative bubbly stone wells and a small flat green duck token resting ON an occupied stone near a meadow shelter. Token stays on its last encounter space, no extra move into a next empty stone. Do not attempt an exact 50-space map, no numbered path labels.
Bottom fold-out physical tray is pale lavender/cream cardboard with navy print and a soft cloudy scalloped silhouette, subtle warm brass edging, excellent roomy readability. It feels part of the tactile tabletop world, not generic app cards.
Three areas in this tray: left approximately26% is a wooden nest-score inset with a clearly illustrated growing twig nest, duck identity medallion and large exact number '24 Twigs', small '+4 tonight', and smaller opponent line 'Rival 21'. This is the persistent match score and a visual nest, not a resource pile to buy with. Middle approximately47% is 'Dream choices', two large seed dream encounter tiles offered on cloud plinths, one orange seed marked1 and one orange seed marked2. Under them rounded cost tabs '3 Sleep' and '6 Sleep'. These prices are illustrative; no extra currency coins. Above these choices a prominent crescent-moon badge and EXACT text 'Sleep score 18' followed by '18 to spend tonight'. Keep earned score fixed for comparison. Right approximately27% is a white feather with '2 Feathers', a modest line '1 Feather = 1 start space', and one slim illustrated dawn-boost ticket titled 'Most Rested Duck', reading 'Start +1 tomorrow' and 'One day only'. This ticket is a transient reward, not a second spendable currency. Small moon/dawn button at bottom 'Ready for dawn'.
Top header left 'NIGHT 4 · DREAMTIME', right small green-duck nest chip '24 Twigs'. Tiny accessible subtitle below header 'Concept A · Dream tray · Illustrative values'. In an upper corner of landscape a very small reference card 'WORLD EVENT' / 'Rain-softened seeds' / 'Seeds move +1 today' so the shared day's context remains inspectable. Good visual hierarchy, few elements, coherent typography, crisp exact short text.
Style: original whimsical cartoon boardgame, smooth clean rich illustration like provided assets, playful rounded dark-indigo lettering, tangible cut-cardboard edges and short contact shadows, moonlit teal/navy outdoors, warm lit nest, lavender dream tray, bright orange seed pieces. Match supplied duck and seed identity. No photographic ducks, standing 3D duck figurines, sci-fi effects, glass UI, neon, tiny unreadable text, excessive grain, coins or Pond penny wording. No code or developer annotations inside the product except the unobtrusive concept subtitle.
b:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: second polished raster concept for Quackies, landscape iPad mini tabletop game. Create ONE full-screen front-on interface, not a device photograph and not a comparison sheet.
Input images: image 1 is approved adventure-board art used ONLY as a small upper-right preview/map button, image 2 is approved flat cardboard duck identity, image 3 approved orange rounded-triangle seed. These are references for the new dream-player-mat UI, not assets to overwrite.
Primary request: show an alternative separate physical NIGHT / DREAM player mat that fills screen after daytime exploration, with a much more prominent nest display. It should feel like turning to the reverse side of a physical personal board. No second path or new game track.
Composition:1536x1024. Beautiful midnight-indigo tabletop backdrop with a few hand-painted stars. One large lavender and parchment folding player mat with rounded scalloped edges occupies screen, clear tactile paperboard material. Top ribbon exact 'NIGHT 4 · DREAMTIME'. Small subtitle 'Concept B · Nest & dream mat · Illustrative values'. Upper right a recognizable miniature of referenced three-biome board in a framed button 'View adventure'.
Left35% of mat: title 'Your nest' then a large endearing original illustrated nest growing from intertwined twigs, modest soft grass lining, a flat cardboard green duck ID medallion beside it. The nest is a score visualization, not where the duck's physical rest position changes to at night. Show large '24 Twigs', smaller '+4 tonight', and a compact comparison below 'You 24' and 'Rival 21' with green and yellow duck medallions. A three-step tiny nest illustration strip 'Beginnings' 'Growing' 'Cosy' shows visual progression only, no mechanical threshold numbers or upgrade buttons.
Right65% mat title 'Dream choices'; top crescent-moon emblem with large 'Sleep score 18' and small '18 to spend tonight'. Two spacious encounter dream choices on cutout cloud plinths: orange seed token1 with tab '3 Sleep', orange seed token2 with tab '6 Sleep'. Printed short footer beneath choices 'New encounters join your bag tomorrow'. A slim horizontal lower strip features white feather icon '2 Feathers' and '1 Feather = 1 start space'. Beside it a separate small dawn ticket 'Most Rested Duck' / 'Start +1 tomorrow' / 'One day only'. Bottom-right main rounded moon-to-sun button 'Ready for dawn'. All numbers illustration only.
Style: same original clean goofy cartoon physical game art as references, readable generously spaced playful lettering and navy ink, matte paperboard, dimensional cut edges but flat token faces, lavender night dreams, warm straw nest, orange seed accents. It must be beautiful and tangible, not a corporate dashboard. Large nest compellingly communicates long-term progress, offers immediately actionable and distinct from score.
Avoid: second movement track, coins, Pond pennies, spend-Twigs buttons, extra resources, many tiny cards, photographic/3D standing ducks, generic app tiles, neon, excess texture/noise. Preserve duck token and seed silhouette identity, make labels crisp and use exact text.
status: Exploratory design study; not approved balance or Unity implementation
